meta.title: Add source generator for compile-time extraction plan compilation
meta.body_summary: Add a .NET source generator to eliminate runtime reflection overhead by compiling extraction plans at compile-time; currently generator does not execute during build.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added a C# source generator to replace runtime reflection, but the generator itself does not execute; PR is open with no reviews and acknowledged incomplete functionality.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 320 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit adding a new source generator project and tests. As a performance enhancement PR aiming to eliminate runtime reflection, it remains open without review, consistent with the author's note that the generator is not yet executing.

review_details.concern_detail: Author acknowledges the source generator is not executing during build; requires further MSBuild or version compatibility investigation.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate runtime reflection overhead by generating compile-time extraction plans.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot attempted a .NET source generator with MSBuild integration; the generator does not execute, indicating insufficient handling of analyzer packaging or project configuration. PR remains open with acknowledged incomplete functionality.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body states generator does not execute, so no performance evidence.

core_change_summary.description: Adds a new .NET source generator project (RegExtract.SourceGenerator) that detects types with REGEXTRACT_REGEX_PATTERN constants and generates static extraction plan classes to avoid runtime reflection; includes test infrastructure and solution integration, but generator does not execute at build time.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Project files and solution updated to include new generator project and tests.
change_trajectory: Created source generator project, syntax receiver, and test class.
Improved generator with debugging and test enhancements.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened the PR with initial implementation.
PR remains open with generator not executing as acknowledged by author.
